entries.title: Job 31:1
segments: ¶"I have made a covenant with my eyes; Why then should I look upon a young woman?

entries.title: Job 31:2
segments: For what [is] the allotment of God from above, And the inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

entries.title: Job 31:3
segments: [Is] it not destruction for the wicked, And disaster for the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Job 31:4
segments: Does He not see my ways, And count all my steps?

entries.title: Job 31:5
segments: "If I have walked with falsehood, Or if my foot has hastened to deceit,

entries.title: Job 31:6
segments: Let me be weighed on honest scales, That God may know my integrity.

entries.title: Job 31:7
segments: If my step has turned from the way, Or my heart walked after my eyes, Or if any spot adheres to my hands,

entries.title: Job 31:8
segments: [Then] let me sow, and another eat; Yes, let my harvest be rooted out.

entries.title: Job 31:9
segments: ¶"If my heart has been enticed by a woman, Or [if] I have lurked at my neighbor's door,

entries.title: Job 31:10
segments: [Then] let my wife grind for another, And let others bow down over her.

entries.title: Job 31:11
segments: For that [would be] wickedness; Yes, it [would be] iniquity [deserving of] judgment.

entries.title: Job 31:12
segments: For that [would be] a fire [that] consumes to destruction, And would root out all my increase.

entries.title: Job 31:13
segments: "If I have despised the cause of my male or female servant When they complained against me,

entries.title: Job 31:14
segments: What then shall I do when God rises up? When He punishes, how shall I answer Him?

entries.title: Job 31:15
segments: Did not He who made me in the womb make them? Did not the same One fashion us in the womb?

entries.title: Job 31:16
segments: ¶"If I have kept the poor from [their] desire, Or caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

entries.title: Job 31:17
segments: Or eaten my morsel by myself, So that the fatherless could not eat of it

entries.title: Job 31:18
segments: (But from my youth I reared him as a father, And from my mother's womb I guided [the widow]);

entries.title: Job 31:19
segments: If I have seen anyone perish for lack of clothing, Or any poor [man] without covering;

entries.title: Job 31:20
segments: If his heart has not blessed me, And [if] he was [not] warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

entries.title: Job 31:21
segments: If I have raised my hand against the fatherless, When I saw I had help in the gate;

entries.title: Job 31:22
segments: [Then] let my arm fall from my shoulder, Let my arm be torn from the socket.

entries.title: Job 31:23
segments: For destruction [from] God [is] a terror to me, And because of His magnificence I cannot endure.

entries.title: Job 31:24
segments: ¶"If I have made gold my hope, Or said to fine gold, '[You are] my confidence';

entries.title: Job 31:25
segments: If I have rejoiced because my wealth [was] great, And because my hand had gained much;

entries.title: Job 31:26
segments: If I have observed the sun when it shines, Or the moon moving [in] brightness,

entries.title: Job 31:27
segments: So that my heart has been secretly enticed, And my mouth has kissed my hand;

entries.title: Job 31:28
segments: This also [would be] an iniquity [deserving of] judgment, For I would have denied God [who is] above.

entries.title: Job 31:29
segments: "If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, Or lifted myself up when evil found him

entries.title: Job 31:30
segments: (Indeed I have not allowed my mouth to sin By asking for a curse on his soul);

entries.title: Job 31:31
segments: If the men of my tent have not said, 'Who is there that has not been satisfied with his meat?'

entries.title: Job 31:32
segments: ([But] no sojourner had to lodge in the street, [For] I have opened my doors to the traveler);

entries.title: Job 31:33
segments: ¶If I have covered my transgressions as Adam, By hiding my iniquity in my bosom,

entries.title: Job 31:34
segments: Because I feared the great multitude, And dreaded the contempt of families, So that I kept silence [And] did not go out of the door-

entries.title: Job 31:35
segments: Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my mark. [Oh, that] the Almighty would answer me, [That] my Prosecutor had written a book!

entries.title: Job 31:36
segments: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, [And] bind it on me [like] a crown;

entries.title: Job 31:37
segments: I would declare to Him the number of my steps; Like a prince I would approach Him.

entries.title: Job 31:38
segments: "If my land cries out against me, And its furrows weep together;

entries.title: Job 31:39
segments: If I have eaten its fruit without money, Or caused its owners to lose their lives;

entries.title: Job 31:40
segments: [Then] let thistles grow instead of wheat, And weeds instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.
